app.name: Health Mapping
app.homeLead: Choose a module on the left, then open a solution. It will load in this pane.
app.tagline: A central platform for health facility, service accessibility, disease surveillance, and food and drugs industry mapping.

footer.blurb: Supporting health planning and service delivery through reliable geospatial information.

disclaimer.title: Data Disclaimer
body: Health Mapping publishes geospatial information for planning and operations.
Users should verify critical decisions against authoritative records.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: Embedded maps may load GeoHub or partner portal content according to each application’s sharing settings.

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: Use this health mapping workspace for official and lawful purposes only.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
body: If you encounter a barrier, contact your GeoHub administrator.

modules.name: Health Service Accessibility
modules.description: Access to health services by location, travel, and coverage.

apps.name: Primary Healthcare Access
apps.description: Population access to primary healthcare facilities.

modules.name: Disease Outbreaks Mapping
modules.description: Disease outbreak reporting and surveillance mapping.

modules.name: Health Emergency
modules.description: Health emergency response, medical services, and field reporting.

apps.name: Health Emergency Response
apps.description: Ambulance dispatch, tasks, and response monitoring.

apps.name: SAMU Reporting Form
apps.description: Field reporting form for SAMU emergency records.

notes: Partner portal base URLs for portalHostKey values (gh, rbc, esrirw) remain deployment-managed.
Survey123 and private dashboard tokens/credentials must never appear in Runtime Config.
